name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.douyinminigame
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (DouYin Mini Game)
description:
DouYin Mini Game keyboard adapter for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. Self-registers into OperationKeyboardRegistry at startup via DouYinMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap (code is stripped and registration does not happen when UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD macros are not enabled; installation implies registration).

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的抖音小游戏键盘适配渠道包。通过 DouYinMiniGameOperationKeyboardBootstrap 在启动阶段自注册进主包 OperationKeyboardRegistry（宏 UNITY_WEBGL / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME / ENABLE_DOUYIN_MINI_GAME_OPERATIONKEYBOARD 未启用时代码被裁剪，注册不会发生；引用即注册）。
